 2026-2027 School Calendar Update! Extended Thanksgiving Holiday 
 2026-2027 School Calendar Update! Extended Thanksgiving Holiday
 Chesapeake Public Schools
 October 30, 2026
 The School Board unanimously approved an update to the 2026–2027 district calendar, officially extending the upcoming 2026 Thanksgiving holiday. 
 Wednesday, November 25, 2026, previously scheduled as an early-release day, will now be a full day off. As a result of a School Board vote on Oct. 29, 2026, all schools and administrative offices will be closed on Wednesday, November 25, through Friday, November 27, 2026, for the Thanksgiving holiday.
 Important Upcoming November Calendar Reminders
 Please keep the following scheduled closures and observances in mind:
 Sunday, November 1, 2026 - Daylight Savings ends! Don’t forget to set your clocks back one hour before bed on Saturday night!
 Tuesday, November 3, 2026 – Election Day / Teacher Workday : Schools are closed for all students.
 Wednesday, November 11, 2026 – Veterans Day : All schools and administrative offices are closed in honor of our nation’s service members.
 Wednesday, November 25 – Friday, November 27 – Thanksgiving Holiday : All schools and offices are closed.
 For the most up-to-date schedule and a comprehensive list of upcoming district events, please visit our full calendar at cpschools.com/events .
